Name: Chao Garden
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I used to love raising Chaos in the Chao gardens in the sonic games. I decided to bring them to Stardew!

This mod includes 6 different types of Chaos for your barn:

Chao
Hero Chao
Dark Chao
Neutral Chaos Chao
Hero Chaos Chao
Dark Chaos Chao

They live in your barns and produce Chao eggs, which can be turned into mayo (but not hatched!) They also will give you Chaos Fruit, which can be turned into wine and jelly.

Usual install instructions, just download, drag and drop into your mod folder.

Enjoy!
